ja255:1.1: ti. Yāvaṃ so mattam aññāsi bhojanasmiṃ vihaṅgamo tāva addhānam āpādi mātarañ ca aposayi.
ja255:2.1: Yato ca so bahutaraṃ bhojanaṃ ajjhupāhari tato tatth' eva saṃsīdi, amattaññū hi so ahu.
ja255:3.1: Tasmā mattaññutā sādhu bhojanasmiṃ agiddhitā, amattaññū hi sīdanti, mattaññū ca na sīdare ti.
